name: message
title: Message
description: Chat message composition with author and timestamp.

files.content:
import type { HTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react"; export function Message({ author, time, avatar, side = "incoming", className = "", children, ...props }: HTMLAttributes & { author: string; time?: string; avatar?: ReactNode; side?: "incoming" | "outgoing" }) { return
{avatar}
{author}{time && {time}}
{children}
; }
